title: Adamantine Shield
summary: Attackers cannot critically hit you. A missed melee attack against you sends the attacker Reeling for 2 turns. Shield Bash. When hit by a melee attack, use a Reaction to attempt to knock the attacker Prone. A Dexterity save resists.
